messages.subject: Failed to factorize Q
parts:
Hi INLA team,

I am working on a spatial model with point and grid data for soil moisture, which includes 20 points and 100 grids. Here is my model:



Here is the main part of the code:

the projection matrix for the grid data: 

Aa <- inla.spde.make.A(mesh = mesh, loc = locin, block = block, block.rescale = "sum")
 
  formula <- Y ~ 0 + alpha_1 + alpha_2 + alpha_3 + x +
